title: Read-only anonymized driver PnP inspection bundle

summary.behavior: A PowerShell 7 collector targets only ROOT\HIBIKIDSP and HibikiVirtualAudio, reads typed PnP problem/service/driver properties plus a bounded SetupAPI tail, redacts local identifiers and writes JSON only below repository .local.
summary.user_impact: The next consent-gated VM retest can distinguish missing-device, service, problem-code and problem-status states and retain a comparable sanitized install excerpt instead of reporting only a generic Code 10.
summary.scope_boundary: Inspection-only source/self-test and host unavailable-path evidence. No device or boot mutation, driver installation, load, PnP start, runtime audio, HLK or Microsoft signing claim.

privacy_and_safety.exact_target: Only instance IDs matching ROOT\HIBIKIDSP and service HibikiVirtualAudio are projected.
privacy_and_safety.redaction: Instance IDs become 16-character SHA-256 tokens; SetupAPI excerpts redact Hibiki instance suffixes, filesystem/UNC paths, SIDs and the computer name.
privacy_and_safety.bounded_output: At most the requested SetupAPI section tail is emitted (default 160 lines), and the destination must remain below .local with no reparse-point parent or directory leaf.
privacy_and_safety.mutation_boundary: The script AST self-test rejects PnP/boot mutation commands; runtime output records mutation_attempted=false.

validation.result: pass; 7 offline cases for output containment, reparse rejection, exact target filtering, typed 10/0xC000000D projection, redaction, bounded SetupAPI extraction and absence of mutating commands
pass on non-guest host; inspection-only; mutation_attempted=false; device_count=0; PnP cmdlets available; missing Hibiki service reported as unavailable; sanitized JSON written under .local

limits: The host run had no Hibiki PnP device or service; it proves honest unavailable behavior, not driver load.
The next Issue #462 guest run still requires explicit user consent before any install, enable, TESTSIGNING or reboot action.
DbgPrintEx stage output requires the separately configured guest/kernel-debug capture path and is not fabricated by this collector.
next_safe_action: After PR review/merge and explicit user consent, run the collector before and immediately after the Issue #462 isolated-VM install/PnP start attempt and compare the sanitized reports.
